title: EdOS Global-Local Localization and Sovereignty Layer
scope: Re-architects locale + global_registries + compliance + siteconfig + brand_experience + metadata + finance + communication + academics + reports + sync_engine + platform_runtime to expose a single Local Overlay service. Builds on the existing 250 ISO2 regional payment profile registry + 25 LocalExperienceProfile + 98-template marketplace + 51-market testimonial voice + per-state India calendar variants + script-aware UI.
